fast.monitor_caveat: Process CPU sampled every 0.5s; short-lived processes may be missed. Affinity overlap is conservative. Events >=0.2 CPU recorded; sum >=0.8 CPU on overlapping affinity invalidates performance. Routine lower-level background activity remains in logs.

refined.monitor_caveat: Process CPU sampled every 0.5s; short-lived processes may be missed. Affinity overlap is conservative. Events >=0.2 CPU recorded; sum >=0.8 CPU on overlapping affinity invalidates performance. Routine lower-level background activity remains in logs.

native_screen_contamination: Observed external hspice/xa CPU workloads after guard start; retained only for correctness.

interpretation.reason: All timed batches had external activity or failed the predeclared monitoring criterion. Timing tables are diagnostic only. The final prototype also has substantial regressions and incomplete production API qualification.
interpretation.monitor_field_note: external_overlap_samples in raw monitor result counts event entries, not necessarily distinct sampling intervals.
